items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The last year that he played in Cuba was at the Montmartre, with Gilberto Valdes.

ctx.x: Well, we were together always. The last year that he played in Cuba was at the Montmartre, with Gilberto Valdes. He made a combination because that was all-white band, but Gilberto Valdes was very liberal. Being white, he was very liberal and he hired Mario.
Mario told me that the last band he worked with and he was discriminated against, was -ah- Curbelo's father, Jose Curbelo's father.
